key_points.text: We're here today because coronavirus is now disrupting the entire healthcare system.
key_points.evidence_quote: We're here today because coronavirus is now disrupting the entire healthcare system, not just because of the burden of dealing with the actual disease itself, but because of everything else that's had to grind to a halt.

thesis: The podcast discusses how the coronavirus outbreak is disrupting cancer treatment by forcing oncologists to make difficult, case-by-case decisions regarding the timing of chemotherapy and other therapies due to a lack of comprehensive data. Speakers argue that while patients have shown remarkable resilience, providers must carefully weigh the risks of recurrence against the dangers of immunosuppression and potential hospital overload when determining whether to proceed with curative or palliative intent treatments.
